Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement readiness & commercial path (PO vs card) — AcmeCloud

Hi Elena —

Great to meet you and the team on the call today. Quick recap and next steps so we have a single source of truth:

Summary of today's discovery:
- Primary use: internal LLM-powered search and contextual assistance for SEs (high QPS, latency-sensitive).
- Data: no PCI/PHI; some customer PII.
- Expected first production traffic: pilot in June, broader roll in Q4.

Commercial path / procurement questions we covered:
- Preferred payment method? PO from finance vs card.
- Marketplace interest: do you want Redwood listed in AcmeCloud Marketplace (can simplify procurement) or go direct?
- Contracting timeline: legal & security review -> finance -> PO issuance.

Attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with proposed milestones for legal/security/finance. Can you confirm the procurement intake contact and whether procurement requires vendor packets or a PO template?

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm procurement contact and whether PO or card is preferred (reply inline).
2) We'll set up a short meeting with Marcus (legal/commercial) and Rachel (security) if you want to triage the questionnaire.
3) We update the MAP and share a final timeline for sign-off.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_acmecloud.xlsx (draft MAP)

Thanks — happy to tighten the dates once I have your intake details.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

--
Redwood Inference — production-first LLM inference platform
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement readiness & commercial path (PO vs card) — AcmeCloud

Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the MAP. A few notes from procurement and legal:

Procurement process (high level):
1) Legal review of standard terms (we'll perform an initial redline). Estimated start: 2026-03-05.
2) Security questionnaire / evidence collection (Infosec will run their checklist). Target completion: 2026-03-10.
3) Finance acceptance and PO issuance (assuming no major legal exceptions). Target: 2026-03-18.

Payment preference: Finance prefers PO for enterprise contracts; card is only for low-value or pilot purchases.

Marketplace: We can evaluate listing on AcmeCloud Marketplace — that process can take longer (4–6 weeks for onboarding). If you can provide a marketplace readiness doc, procurement will review that in parallel.

I've attached our procurement intake form and included our procurement inbox on CC. Please loop Marcus and Rachel for any legal/security follow-up.

Attachments: procurement_intake_form_acmecloud.pdf

Elena Torres
Head of Procurement (AcmeCloud)
elena.torres@acmecloud.com

Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement readiness & commercial path (PO vs card) — AcmeCloud

Thanks, Elena — this is super helpful. A few clarifications and our proposed milestone dates (also updated in the attached timeline):

We confirm the commercial path options:
- Preferred: PO (enterprise) — we'll prepare a standard order form and invoice template for Finance.
- Alternative: Card for a small pilot (if you want to accelerate initial testing).
- Marketplace: Redwood can initiate marketplace onboarding in parallel but understand it may not speed the initial PO.

Proposed milestone check-ins (draft):
- 2026-03-05: Legal kickoff (Marissa + Marcus + Acme legal).
- 2026-03-10: Security questionnaire completion (Rachel to coordinate with Acme InfoSec).
- 2026-03-12: Commercial terms lock (price, term length, SOW scope).
- 2026-03-18: Target PO issuance / contract signature.

Action items for this week:
- Elena / Procurement: confirm procurement contact and PO template (if any).
- Acme legal: send preferred redlines by 2026-03-09 so we can triage.
- Redwood (Marcus): I'll ask Marcus to prepare a short redline-friendly order form and highlight any non-negotiable items.
- Redwood (Rachel): please prep the standard security evidence bundle (SOC 2, data flow diagram, retention policy) and indicate any gaps.

If these dates look good to you I can lock them into the MAP and we can set two 30-minute checkpoints (legal kickoff on 3/5 and check-in after security on 3/11).

Attachments: procurement_timeline_draft.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marissa
